text: 明日方舟背景插件（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DSH Web 界面铺设明日方舟壁纸，并通过渐变纱幕保持界面内容清晰。Node 端注册精确图片路由，浏览器端注入样式表。主要效果包括全屏壁纸、柔和极光动画、聊天与外壳透明化，以及代码块和终端的毛玻璃表面。适合希望自定义 DSH Web 视觉风格的用户；需要 DSH Web 提供 webserver 服务，不需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

Arknights Background (DSH Web): adds a wallpaper, gradient veil, and drifting aurora. Node serves the image; browser styles reveal transparent chat and frosted code and terminal panels. Requires the DSH webserver; no API keys.
想给 DSH 网页界面换成明日方舟主题背景。
能不能让聊天页面背景显示一张壁纸？
我想给 Web 版界面加渐变遮罩和缓慢流动的光效。
让代码块和终端看起来像背景上的半透明毛玻璃。
希望聊天区域透明一些，能露出页面背景。
I want a custom wallpaper behind my DSH web chat.
Can the code panes look frosted while still showing the background?
Add a subtle animated aurora effect to the web interface.
明日方舟背景插件的功能「全屏壁纸」：在 html 与 body 上绘制随包提供的壁纸，并叠加纵向渐变与径向暗角。页面加载样式后即可显示。
明日方舟背景插件的功能「动态极光」：在背景上方绘制柔和色光并缓慢旋转缩放；用户启用减少动态效果偏好时会关闭动画。
明日方舟背景插件的功能「毛玻璃编码面板」：为代码预览、代码块、终端及工具输出设置半透明渐变和背景模糊，让内容后方透出壁纸。
明日方舟背景插件的功能「随包图片路由」：Node 端在 /arknights-wallpaper.webp 提供 WebP 壁纸，支持 GET 与 HEAD；缺少图片时返回 404。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-arknights-background README · @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-arknights-background：Web background plugin: paints the Arknights wallpaper over the web shell. The client bundle's entire effect is one stylesheet (`src/client/arknights.module.css`), injected as a `<style data-plugin>` tag when the bundle materializes; the node half owns the art itself, registering one exact `/arknights-wallpaper.webp` route that serves the packaged `arknights-wallpaper.webp`, so the effect no longer depends on the deployment's frontend dist. The package ships its own composition layer (`dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml`), so `dsh plugin --profile web add <package>` mounts the browser row without hand-editing a profile patch.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-arknights-background README · @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-arknights-background：The sheet paints the wallpaper on `html` and `body` under two gradient layers — a vertical readability veil whose stops follow the art's own shading (dark blue-gray sky, light center, warm dark foreground) plus a radial vignette — and a `body::before` aurora of two soft color glows slowly rotates and scales above the wallpaper (disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`). The full-viewport shell surfaces are lifted so the art shows through: every slot render is wrapped in a `[data-slot="<key>"]` anchor (`display: contents`), so the AppFrame (`#root > [data-slot="root"] > div`) becomes transparent and the conversation column root (`[data-slot="conversation"] > [data-phase]`) is lifted too, with the composer seat's fade band cleared as well; the sidebar keeps a translucent dark gradient through its `--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill` token. The right sidebar is a dockkit tree whose docked pane box carries the opaque base token — the box that hid the wallpaper when a file was open — so `[data-dockkit-host='dock'] > [data-dockkit-pane]` is lifted to transparent while floating panes stay opaq

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-arknights-background README · @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-arknights-background：The shell selectors track the slot-system DOM rather than hashed class names (documented in the stylesheet): each slot render is anchored by a `[data-slot="<key>"]` wrapper, the AppFrame is its `> div`, and `[data-phase]` is the conversation column root's always-present attribute (the shell keys that slot `main.conversation`, so the sheet matches it by suffix as well as by the literal key). Both are asserted by the package spec. Every rule is plain CSS — no `:global()` wrappers: the sheet is compiled into the bundle ahead of Vite's CSS-modules pass, so a `:global(...)` selector would reach the browser verbatim, where it is an unknown pseudo-class and its whole rule is dropped (that is what silently disabled this sheet's transparency rules).
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-arknights-background README · Model Experience：None, as the plugin is a browser-side paint layer plus one static image route; nothing here reaches a model request.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-arknights-background README · KV Cache effect：None; this package neither assembles nor sends a provider request.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-arknights-background README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **Structural selectors** — the transparency overrides match the shell DOM positionally; a future shell that wraps the AppFrame or the conversation root in another element would need the selectors updated (the spec pins the current contract).
- **Fixed image URL** — the painted path is a package literal (`/arknights-wallpaper.webp`); the node half serves it from the packaged `arknights-wallpaper.webp`, so swapping the art means replacing that one file in the package (no stylesheet or frontend-dist change).
